title.narrative: Strengthening the capacities of the DRC Ministry of Urbanism and Habitat to develop an effective legal framework for urban development and construction

description.narrative:
With the DRC is undergoing a rapid urbanization process according to the outdated urban planning legislation, there is a strong need for technical support in legal drafting, capacity development in legislative reform and stakeholders’ engagement in this sphere. Thus, the focus of the project is on strengthening the capacities of the national government to develop an effective legal framework for urban planning, in consultation with relevant stakeholders and improving the overall urban governance.
To achieve the challenges mentioned above, the project is based on a three-pronged approach comprising of:
(1) Capacity development strategy aimed to identify the specific capacity development needs of the Ministry through needs assessment that, in order to achieve results, is developed in collaboration with relevant stakeholders and through several means (like auto evaluation, interviews and discussion groups). With consideration of the results received, the UN-Habitat will develop a capacity development strategy.
(2) Stakeholders’ engagement strategy aimed to engage stakeholders in the legislative reform process and foster participatory governance. UN-Habitat will map relevant stakeholders and create focus groups which will take part in the legislative process proposing suggestions and recommendations that will be then integrated in the new draft law.
(3) Drafting the new urbanization law: UN-Habitat will review the current draft law together with relevant institutions, will verify its compatibility with the overall urban legal system and will support the conversion of stakeholders’ suggestions into legal provisions with consideration of institutional and financial framework and an implementation structure.
